correctness.rationale: The sixteen standard \((-1)\)-classes on the degree-four del Pezzo were independently reconstructed. Exact intersection pairing gives a 5-regular triangle-free graph with 40 double points, so \(\chi(W)=32-40=-8\); the blow-up surface has \(\chi(X)=8\), hence \(\chi(Y)=16\). The squaring map is finite and identifies \(Y\) as the finite inverse image of the affine discriminant-conic complement, so \(Y\) is a smooth affine complex surface and has finite CW dimension at most two. With the published \(H_1(Y,\mathbf Z)\cong\mathbf Z^{10}\), this forces free \(H_2(Y,\mathbf Z)\cong\mathbf Z^{25}\) and zero higher homology. Hopf gives a surjection to the published free group-homology group of rank 25, hence an isomorphism. The conclusion concerns only the Hurewicz image, not vanishing of \(\pi_2\).
